title: A Alibi for the Verdict Revisited
premise: Beatrix Oyelaran, the observant concierge of the Grand Meridian Hotel, receives two letters on the same morning: one confessing to a death she once proved was murder, the other promising a fourth. As she investigates, she learns the confessed killer is innocent and that the true architect of the deaths is someone inside her own circle—her mentor, the hotel's beloved head concierge, who has been eliminating witnesses to an old crime. The witness everyone swears is dead is alive: a former chambermaid hiding in plain sight as the hotel's night auditor. At the anniversary dinner, Beatrix exposes the conspiracy before the final toast, choosing truth over the loyalty that nearly destroyed her.
about_author: Rosalind Oyelaran spent a decade working hotel front desks in three countries before turning her eye for human behavior to fiction. She writes mysteries about people the world overlooks, insisting that the best detectives are those paid to be invisible.

chapters.title: Miriam Comes In From the Dark
